name: Outdoor Heritage Fund Call for Funding Request
summary: Annual open call in Minnesota for habitat programmes and projects that restore, protect and enhance wetlands, prairies, forests and habitat for fish, game and wildlife. The council recommends winners to the legislature for appropriation.

amount.note: Requests under $500,000 go to the Conservation Partners Legacy Program.
